preview.binaryBody: Open it in Godmode on your computer.

preview.imageFailedBody: Your computer didn't send it. Check that Godmode runs there.

readOnly.claude: Generated from the agent's settings. Edit the instructions in Settings instead.
readOnly.state: Snapshot written by Godmode. Changes would be overwritten.

editor.conflictBody: {{agent}} may have rewritten it. Reload to see the new version (your edits are discarded), or overwrite it with yours.

name.pinned: Named in {{names}}. Change the name there too, or the agent looks for the old one.

errors.dot: Names can't start with a dot here.

move.title: Move {{name}}
move.changeHint: Change the path there too, or the agent looks for it in the old place.

delete.description_one: It goes to {{name}}'s bin: you can put it back there for 30 days.
delete.description_other: They go to {{name}}'s bin: you can put them back there for 30 days.
delete.mayNeedOne: It may still need it. Remove the mention too, or keep the file.
delete.mayNeedMany: It may still need them. Remove the mention too, or keep the files.

bin.title: Recently deleted
bin.keptWith: {{items}} · {{size}} · kept {{days}} days, then the daily cleanup removes them.
bin.emptyDescription: What you delete here waits {{days}} days, so you can put it back.
bin.confirmDeleteBody: It can't be put back afterwards.
bin.historyNote: Files the agent had committed stay in its version history.

review.title: Review

build.title: Installed packages and build output
build.hint: Installing or building again brings them back.

junk.title: Junk files
junk.hint: Logs, temporary files and Finder leftovers.

duplicate.title: Copies
duplicate.hint: The same content lies somewhere else too. The other copy stays.

large.title: Large files
large.hint: Check whether they are still needed.

scratch.title: Large scratch in tmp/
scratch.hint: Goes by itself a week after its last change. Delete now to free the space today.

stale.title: Untouched for 30 days
stale.hint: Old reports, exports and experiments: keep what still matters.

loose.title: Unsorted
loose.hint: Loose files at the top: sort them into a folder.

unlinkedNote.hint: Memory notes without a link from MEMORY.md are rarely read: link, merge or delete them.

brokenLink.hint: The memory points at notes that don't exist: fix the link in the note.

review.partial: very large, not everything was looked at
review.tidyDescription: No build output, junk, copies or forgotten notes. The nightly dream keeps sorting the workspace too.
